references.text: Beth-Horon is mentioned as a place where the Lord cast great stones from heaven upon the enemy during Joshua's battle against the Amorites.
Beth-Horon is mentioned as part of the border of the tribe of Benjamin, which borders the territory of Ephraim.
Beth-Horon is listed as a Levitical city given to the sons of Kohath from the tribe of Ephraim.
Gezer is mentioned in connection with the Philistine border and Saul's battle against them.
Gezer is mentioned as a Levitical city given to the sons of Kohath.
Gezer and its king were defeated by Joshua during the conquest of Canaan.
The king of Gezer is listed among the kings whom Joshua defeated.
Ephraim did not drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer, but they continued to live among them.
